name: Achiri waitlist command — /waitlist saves chatId for alpha invite management
goal: Add /waitlist command to Telegram bot. Any user can /waitlist to join the Achiri alpha waitlist (chatId + name saved to workspace/achiri/waitlist.jsonl). /waitlist list (owner-only) shows all waitlist entries + count. This gives the operator a managed list of users to invite when setting ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST on Apr 25.
rationale: Alpha launch is Apr 25 (40 days). Without a waitlist, operator has no way to know who wants access and must manually collect chatIds. /waitlist = zero-friction alpha pipeline. Operator can copy chatIds from /waitlist list directly into ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST env var.
swarm: NOT USED — 2 file edits (commands.ts + index.ts) + 1 new file (waitlist.jsonl data dir). Direct write.

tasks.title: agents/telegram-bot/commands.ts — handleWaitlist()
tasks.description: Add handleWaitlist(chatId, subCmd, ownerChatId). Logic: if subCmd === 'list' and chatId === ownerChatId: load waitlist.jsonl, format list with chatId + name + joinedAt, send to owner. Otherwise (any user): check if chatId already on waitlist (no duplicates), append entry {chatId, firstName, username, joinedAt} to workspace/achiri/waitlist.jsonl, confirm with 'You're on the Achiri alpha waitlist! We'll notify you when it launches (Apr 25).' If already on list: 'You're already on the waitlist — we'll let you know when it's ready!'

tasks.title: agents/telegram-bot/index.ts — /waitlist dispatch
tasks.description: Add handleWaitlist to imports from ./commands. Add case '/waitlist' to the dispatch switch: await handleWaitlist(chatId, text.split(/\s+/)[1], OWNER_CHAT_ID). OWNER_CHAT_ID is already in scope as a const. /waitlist is NOT behind beta gate — any user can join the waitlist even during beta.

tasks.title: agents/telegram-bot/commands.ts — handleHelp() add /waitlist
tasks.description: Add '/waitlist — Join Achiri alpha waitlist (launches Apr 25)' to the Achiri section of handleHelp().

tasks.title: scripts/achiri/validate-sprint-136.ts — validation
tasks.description: Check: (1) handleWaitlist exported from commands.ts, (2) /waitlist case in index.ts dispatch switch, (3) handleHelp contains /waitlist, (4) dry-run handleWaitlist by calling the function with a test chatId against a temp file, (5) duplicate prevention (calling twice doesn't add second entry).
